description: Published vector values that changed between mvp-0.2-baseline.3 and mvp-0.2-baseline.4, each with the decision that approved it. Checked by scripts/check-baseline-changes.mjs; any other changed or removed value fails validation.

changed.rule: Orchestrator decision (2026-10-09, option a), SHARED-SECTIONS-PROFILE-01 §14.1: a refused change is named only when its bytes are one type 1 change chunk of exact length, by the SHA-256 of the chunk from its type byte on, without decoding. A refused compressed chunk (type 2) is not named: its old name was the hash of the inflated change, and inflating refused bytes has no limit (a zip bomb). The refusal and its diagnostic are unchanged; the entry has no change field.
